jobs.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works. Production-ready deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere. About the Role As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale. You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations. This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve. This role is based in Munich/Berlin. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. You see what needs to happen, take initiative, and enjoy working openly in a fast-moving, international team that's growing together. You take ownership end to end, hold yourself to a high standard, and focus on outcomes that matter for the customer. You believe the best work happens in an environment where people support each other, share knowledge, and grow together. jobs.description: Good product search does more than return a list of results. It helps people find what they came for, even as expectations change with conversational search. At idealo, you own the on-page search experience from the first query to the moment someone finds the right product. You set its direction and make sure search delivers measurable results for users and the business. Your responsibilities Define and measure search success, then decide where to invest next. Shape the search roadmap with engineers, from discovery to release and learning. Run A/B tests: form hypotheses, interpret results and apply what you learn. Study search queries and gaps. When users find products, you see the result. Compare technical search approaches with engineers and choose what fits. Explain decisions and findings to stakeholders and keep search goals clear. Skills & Requirements Must-have Experience with search at scale, including indexing, retrieval and ranking. Ability to discuss search technologies and technical trade-offs with engineers. You use search metrics to make decisions and communicate clearly in written and spoken English. Hands-on A/B testing, from designing experiments to interpreting and applying results. You take ownership and independently drive topics forward. Nice-to-have Knowledge of e-commerce or price comparison, machine learning, or German is a plus. At idealo you can expect You want to further your education? We take your personal development goals seriously and, in addition to our idealo Learning Hub, eLearning offerings (e.g., Udemy), coaching & mediation, we also offer you the opportunity to benefit individually from additional learning and development budget. jobs.title: Rust Software Engineer - Rust / C++ (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Quantum Systems develops autonomous, multi-domain systems that operate in the air, on the ground and on the water. Behind every platform is software that has to work reliably in the real world, with limited resources, unreliable connectivity and no second chances. We are looking for software engineers who like to build exactly that kind of software in Rust and C++. You will join our engineering organization and work on production code that runs on real vehicles and sensors, across a broad range of challenges from low-level systems to scalable services. We are looking for engineers who quickly understand a complex system and its domain, and who use that understanding to get leverage: designing the architecture, setting the guardrails and guiding several AI agents at once to build, test and iterate faster, while taking full responsibility for the result. What is your Day to Day Mission: Build and maintain production-grade software in Rust and C++ for autonomous platforms and the systems around them. Design performant, fault-tolerant components that run on embedded Linux, edge hardware and in the cloud. Develop communication layers, data pipelines and real-time processing for sensor-driven, distributed systems. Work with hardware and robotics engineers to get software from simulation and test benches onto real vehicles. Use AI agents as part of your daily engineering workflow: break down problems, run several agents in parallel, review their output critically and make sure it meets our quality and safety standards. Own your code end to end: design, review, testing, deployment and troubleshooting of systems in the field. Shape architecture decisions and help raise engineering standards in a growing team. What you bring to the team: Several years of professional experience (ideally 4+) building software in Rust and/or C++, including production code. A strong foundation in systems programming: concurrency, memory and resource management, networking and performance tuning.

jobs.title: Junior Product Manager:in
jobs.description: Über Valova Wir bauen die KI-Betriebsplattform für Europas Krankenhäuser, damit sich jede Ärztin und jeder Arzt auf die Patienten konzentrieren kann. Hinter jedem Fall steht eine Kette administrativer Aufgaben: Dokumentation, Kodierung, Abrechnung, Prüfungen, Planung. Sie läuft über getrennte Systeme und unzählige manuelle Übergaben, während die meisten deutschen Kliniken bereits rote Zahlen schreiben. Wir starten dort, wo der Effekt ab Tag eins messbar ist: vom Fall bis zum Geldeingang. Valova kodiert jeden Fall, verteidigt ihn in der Prüfung und sorgt dafür, dass das Geld ankommt. Von dort übernehmen wir jeden Workflow eines Krankenhauses, bis ein agentisches System die Routine erledigt und Menschen über Ausnahmen entscheiden. Erst Deutschland, dann Europa. Ein Team aus Ärzt:innen, Engineers, Strategieberater:innen und Start-up-Profis. Vor Ort in München und Berlin. Wir freuen uns auf dich! Warum diese Rolle wichtig ist Mit Valova kodieren Kliniken ihre Fälle schon heute deutlich schneller. Und das ist erst der Anfang: Wir bauen Valova Schritt für Schritt über die Kodierung hinaus aus, und jede Erweiterung muss im Klinikalltag funktionieren, nicht nur in der Demo. Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel. Du findest heraus, wo Kodierteams Zeit und Erlöse verlieren, entscheidest mit, was wir als Nächstes bauen, und bringst es mit unserem Engineeringteam live. Du bist die Brücke zwischen Klinik und Code und zwischen unserem Team und den Menschen, die täglich mit Valova arbeiten. Was Du bewirkst, siehst Du schwarz auf weiß: in weniger Minuten pro Fall und in mehr Fällen, die Valova ohne Korrektur abrechnet. Deine Rolle im Team Du berichtest direkt an Malte, unseren Produkt Lead, und arbeitest täglich mit unseren Engineers zusammen. Fachlich arbeitest Du eng mit unseren Kodier- und Abrechnungsexpert:innen: Sie kennen die Regeln, Du machst daraus Produkt. In Klinikprojekten arbeitest Du Hand in Hand mit unserem Vertrieb und Customer Success und auf Klinikseite mit Medizincontrol

jobs.title: Lead Homologation Engineer (m/w/d) – EU-Typgenehmigung
jobs.description: Du bringst die neue Generation auf Europas Straßen. Bei HEERO Motors entwickeln wir ein neues elektrisches Fahrgestell für den europäischen Markt – Designed in Munich, kompatibel zum europäischen Aufbauherstellernetzwerk, gemacht für Betriebe, die jeden Tag liefern müssen. 2027 steht die Typgenehmigung an. Die Weichen dafür stellen wir jetzt. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du sorgst dafür, dass unser Fahrzeug von Anfang an homologationsfähig entwickelt wird – und führst die Genehmigung anschließend selbst durch. Keine Zuarbeit, keine Schnittstellenpflege. Du bist die Person, die am Ende den Weg zur Zulassung frei gemacht hat. Was du verantwortest Homologationsfähigkeit von Tag eins: regulatorische Anforderungen identifizieren und verbindlich in Lastenheft und Produktspezifikation verankern Homologationsstrategie weiterentwickeln und umsetzen: unseren Genehmigungsweg nach (EU) 2018/858 schärfen und konsequent umsetzen – inklusive Mehrstufengenehmigung gemeinsam mit Aufbauherstellern Genehmigung selbst durchführen: Prüfprogramme planen, Tests begleiten, Dokumentation erstellen, Termine mit Technischen Diensten und Genehmigungsbehörde führen Entwicklungspartner steuern: Nachweise, Gutachten und Daten bei unserem Fahrzeugpartner und Zulieferern einfordern und auf Vollständigkeit prüfen Regulatorik im Blick: General Safety Regulation, Hochvoltsicherheit, EMV, Cybersecurity und Software-Updates – und was kommt Fundament für die Serie: Conformity of Production, Änderungsmanagement und Varianten so aufsetzen, dass wir schnell neue Aufbauten und Derivate bringen können Was du mitbringst Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Fahrzeughomologation, idealerweise Nutzfahrzeuge (N1/N2) bei OEM, Aufbauhersteller oder Technischem Dienst Sicherer Umgang mit EU-Typgenehmigungsrecht und UN-Regelungen; Erfahrung mit Elektrofahrzeugen ist ein klares Plus Mindestens eine Typgenehmigung, die du maßgeblich selbst verantwortet hast Technisches Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation Hartnäckigkei

jobs.title: Lead Vehicle Cybersecurity Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Du sicherst die Fahrzeuge, auf die sich Europas Betriebe morgen verlassen. Bei HEERO Motors entwickeln wir die neue Generation elektrischer Nutzfahrzeuge – Designed in Munich, gebaut für Handwerk, Logistik und Kommunen. Unser Fahrgestell ist vernetzt vom ersten Tag an: Telematik, Over-the-Air-Updates, HEERO Cloud. Damit wird Cybersecurity nicht zum Prüfpunkt am Ende, sondern zur Grundlage von Zuverlässigkeit – und Zuverlässigkeit ist unsere eigentliche Währung. Wir suchen niemanden, der Anforderungen verwaltet. Wir suchen jemanden, der sie löst. Du baust die Cybersecurity unserer neuen Generation auf, arbeitest selbst an der Fahrzeugsoftware und bist für unsere Entwicklungspartner die Instanz, an der kein Release vorbeigeht. Was du verantwortest Cybersecurity der neuen Generation end-to-end: vom Steuergerät über die Telematik bis in die HEERO Cloud Hands-on an der Software: Threat Analysis & Risk Assessment (TARA) erstellen, Security-Konzepte umsetzen, Code und Architekturen reviewen, Schwachstellen selbst analysieren und schließen CSMS und SUMS aufbauen: unser Cybersecurity- und Software-Update-Management nach UN R155, UN R156 und ISO/SAE 21434 – so, dass es in der Typgenehmigung trägt Partner steuern: Fahrzeug-, Software- und Cloud-Partner technisch führen, Anforderungen festlegen, Nachweise einfordern, Abstimmungen auf Augenhöhe treiben Sicher über den Lebenszyklus: Monitoring, Incident Response und sichere OTA-Prozesse für eine Flotte, die jahrelang im Einsatz ist Brücke zur Homologation: gemeinsam mit unserem Homologation Lead die Cybersecurity-Nachweise für Technische Dienste und Behörde liefern Was du mitbringst Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Automotive Cybersecurity, idealerweise bei OEM, Tier-1 oder Engineering-Dienstleister Tiefes Verständnis von Fahrzeug-E/E-Architekturen, Embedded- und Backend-Systemen; du liest und schreibst Code Praxis mit UN R155/R156 und ISO/SAE 21434 – nicht nur auf Folie, sondern im Audit Erfahrung in der Steuerung externer Entwicklung

jobs.title: (Senior) B2G Manager: Public Sector & Research Funding (f/m/d)
jobs.description: “This is not your typical B2G role.” B2G sounds boring, until you realise it's money from the state and you own it. You'll be responsible for a big share of RIZM's funding sources, with real influence on RIZM's cash flow and on how fast we grow. You'll be tapping into new sources that most companies never even look at. Why this role exists RIZM builds RIZMO, an AI agent that makes energy decisions for industrial companies. Our next lever is the public sector: municipalities, utilities and economic development agencies have to implement heat plans, keep business parks competitive and relieve the grid. We're looking for someone to own B2G as a business line at RIZM, from public funding all the way to municipalities as paying customers. What you'll own Public funding as a growth channel. Forschungszulage (Germany's R&D tax allowance), EU grants, ERDF (EFRE) and other programmes: build the pipeline, actively own and track our running programmes, forge consortia and get applications approved. Connect research. Coordinate our research collaboration with Stanford and translate it into funded projects. Build the machine, AI-first. Set up your own systems, tracking and automation, so one person can run a funding pipeline that usually takes a whole team. You decide how the role works behind the scenes. Take over and scale ReNET-EV. Own our part of the ERDF project ReNET-EV (grid-friendly energy supply for business parks in the Münster/NRW region) and roll the model out to more municipalities. Turn municipalities into customers. Win cities, municipal utilities and economic development agencies that use RIZM for heat planning, climate strategy and business park development. Set up offers and procurement routes for the public sector. Orchestrate the ecosystem. Bring chambers of commerce (IHKs), economic development agencies, utilities and industry partners together in joint projects. Build the data foundation. Tap into public and municipal data that makes our models more precise

jobs.title: Rust Software Engineer - Rust / C++ (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Quantum Systems develops autonomous, multi-domain systems that operate in the air, on the ground and on the water. Behind every platform is software that has to work reliably in the real world, with limited resources, unreliable connectivity and no second chances. We are looking for software engineers who like to build exactly that kind of software in Rust and C++. You will join our engineering organization and work on production code that runs on real vehicles and sensors, across a broad range of challenges from low-level systems to scalable services. We are looking for engineers who quickly understand a complex system and its domain, and who use that understanding to get leverage: designing the architecture, setting the guardrails and guiding several AI agents at once to build, test and iterate faster, while taking full responsibility for the result. What is your Day to Day Mission: Build and maintain production-grade software in Rust and C++ for autonomous platforms and the systems around them. Design performant, fault-tolerant components that run on embedded Linux, edge hardware and in the cloud. Develop communication layers, data pipelines and real-time processing for sensor-driven, distributed systems. Work with hardware and robotics engineers to get software from simulation and test benches onto real vehicles. Use AI agents as part of your daily engineering workflow: break down problems, run several agents in parallel, review their output critically and make sure it meets our quality and safety standards. Own your code end to end: design, review, testing, deployment and troubleshooting of systems in the field. Shape architecture decisions and help raise engineering standards in a growing team. What you bring to the team: Several years of professional experience (ideally 4+) building software in Rust and/or C++, including production code. A strong foundation in systems programming: concurrency, memory and resource management, networking and performance tuning.

jobs.description: An Introduction to Primer Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. This is a hands-on role. You'll work the access and IT queue with the team, and you'll lead the technical work that shrinks it: the automation, the identity platform and the roadmap. As Primer grows and the team grows with it, there's room for the role to grow too, including into leading the team for the right person. Tech is an enablement team. Primer is growing fast, and access requests are growing even faster. Our job is to make getting the right access quick, safe and mostly automatic, so people can get on with their work and our security engineers can get back to security. What you'll be doing Work the IAM, IT and Workplace Tech queue alongside the team, and set the bar for turnaround and quality. Lead the technical roadmap for Tech and deliver it, starting with SCIM day-1 provisioning, Okta, automated access reviews and device enrolment. Automate the routine. Use identity tooling, scripting, workflow automation and AI to take repetitive access requests off people's plates. Run joiner, mover and leaver processes so new starters have what they need on day one and access is removed promptly when it should be.

Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l’appartement parisien d’Auguste Perret (La Croisière). Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d’ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street) et Dubai. jobs.title: Entrepreneur Intern
jobs.description: About SeeSicht Gmbh SeeSicht is a small family office of AI-first companies. We build companies that are profitable today and keep them for the long term — not a venture builder chasing funding rounds. Every project is funded 100% by me or by me and my network. No investor search, no fundraising rounds. Your first months at SeeSicht Gmbh You will take on core business development tasks, working alongside experienced team members to support company initiatives. Through daily operations, you will learn how the business scales and manage assigned projects within a hybrid work environment. What you will do You execute. I bring the ideas, the network and the money — you turn them into real products, pages, campaigns and processes. You build and test the way we always do it: build a sellable prototype (CHF 100–1,000), test it on the market with Facebook ads (CHF 5,000–10,000), build the product fully (CHF 10,000–20,000), then launch with real marketing spend. MyBikePlan is the proof: 2019 idea, one-week website, one week of Facebook marketing, CHF 500 invested → 30 pre-orders. 2020 launch with CHF 1M in the first year, 2021 team, 2025 sold close to CHF 20M. The playbook is set — you run it on new projects. Current projects: Fairbroker.ch (AI insurance broker, market test now, live Q1 2027), a kettlebell workout app (52-card deck, early prototype, suppliers in China secured), and Glanzio (B2B store-window cleaning, launch test Q1 2027). The timeline — how it works Months 1–12 — the internship: CHF 2,500/month, full-time, paid, and inside that year up to 10% of the profit of the project/company you work on. jobs.title: Stage Bouw
jobs.description: Hé stage topper! Kom jij, net als vele andere stagiaires, stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo? Bij ons krijg jij de kans om mee te denken, werken én ontwikkelen aan gave projecten binnen Noord, Midden en Oost-Nederland. Wij hebben weer volop stageplekken vanaf Februari 2027 op onze bouwen en op kantoor! Dit wordt jouw stage Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo ga je aan de slag op ons kantoor of op één van onze projecten. We kijken in overeenstemming welke afdeling of welk project het beste bij jou en/of de opdracht past. Tijdens je stage word je goed begeleid door één van onze collega’s en krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen! Jij staat aan het stuur van je eigen ontwikkeling tijdens je stageperiode: Hoe meer jij wil leren, hoe meer jij kan leren! Naast dat je zelfstandig aan een opdracht kan werken wordt je ook begeleidt door een senior collega die jou alle kneepjes van het vak gaat leren. We hebben door heel ons werkgebied verschillende bouwen waar we ruimte hebben voor een stagiaire, stuur ons vooral een berichtje zodat we samen kunnen kijken wat passend is! Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een familiebedrijf. Een onafhankelijke bouwonderneming actief in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek in Nederland. Al sinds 1855 vormen onze onafhankelijkheid en langjarige continuïteit de basis voor onze strategie. Met een omzet van circa € 1,8 miljard en ruim 3.000 medewerkers behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Samen realiseren we prachtige projecten. Iconische, en soms ook alledaagse projecten waarmee we nieuwe antwoorden bieden op maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Waarmee we de beste oplossingen voor morgen garanderen en het verschil maken voor Nederland, juist op de langere termijn. We hebben stevige ambities – en daarvoor geldt dat we die alleen kunnen waarmaken dankzij onze mensen. Als beste werkgever maken wij ons er daarom hard voor dat jij elke dag opnieuw kiest voor Dura Vermeer

Daarbij begrijp je niet alleen de commerciële kant van partnerships, maar ook hoe de paymentketen inhoudelijk werkt. Your role Fastned aims to accelerate the transition towards sustainable mobility by giving fast charging to electric drivers. The stakes are high: Fastned handles 23,000+ charging sessions a day, and every one of those payments goes through our systems. We’re now moving towards real-time payments, where each session is paid instantly instead of invoiced later. As we are growing and adding roaming features as a Mobility Service Provider, there are many scale relevant challenges to solve. We have no legacy systems. You’ll work with Kotlin 2.x, Java 21+, and Spring Boot 4 on most services, AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, SQL (Postgres), Terraform, GitLab CI/CD and REST APIs to build scalable, fault-tolerant services that drivers and our Finance team rely on every day

Jouw baan als Grondwerker bij RECO Als Grondwerker Bouwplaatsinrichting bij RECO werk je elke dag buiten op verschillende bouwplaatsen in Nederland. Samen met collega’s zorg je ervoor dat alles wat nodig is op en rond de bouwplaats goed wordt voorbereid en aangelegd. Je doet graafwerk, legt voorzieningen aan en helpt mee bij technische werkzaamheden. Je werkt vaak samen in een duo en bent bezig met praktisch werk waar je aan het einde van de dag duidelijk resultaat van ziet. Geen dag is hetzelfde: de ene keer sta je op een nieuw project, de andere keer werk je verder waar je gisteren bent begonnen. Kort gezegd: jij maakt de bouwplaats klaar zodat anderen veilig en goed hun werk kunnen doen. jobs.description: Jouw Missie bij CCS Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam. Voordelen voor de sollicitant Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar). Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks. En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch? Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. jobs.description: ABOUT INSIFY We sell a mix of insurance products to small businesses (SME's) in the Netherlands, Germany and France, and we are in the process of scaling into more markets. Insurance infrastructure is brutal to get right. Every carrier has its own spec, every product its own underwriting rules, every country its own regulatory requirements. Most insurers throw people and process at that complexity - one-off integrations, workarounds on workarounds. We're building it differently: our insurance platform is where we consolidate that complexity, so that launching a new product or market becomes a configuration exercise rather than a rebuild. Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by more than €40M from investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance. About the role You would join the Shop team, responsible for everything that happens after a small business buys a policy from us. You would help shape how the platform handles the next product and the next country, on a system already carrying live policies and real customers. The team owns end-to-end policy lifecycle management (mid-term adjustments, automated renewals, cancellations, and payment flows) alongside the backoffice tooling that gives our operations and support teams full visibility and control. We work closely with the Claims Team, and with the Activation Teams that turn a lead into a paying customer. Product and engineering together are 30+ people. Every country has its own regulatory quirks, and every insurance product has unique data structures, lifecycle rules, and money flows. As we expand across Europe, our goal isn't to write custom glue code for every new launch. It's to design elegant, reusable platform abstractions. Funded entirely from its own operating cash. We have never taken outside capital. The other half is making security AI-driven: mapping our full surface and building agentic systems that test, monitor and audit it with near-total coverage, so security keeps pace as more of the company runs on AI. This is a player-coach role: about half hands-on, leading a small team of engineers. You report to Group leadership, brief the leadership team monthly, and are the person they trust to explain risk in plain language and make the call under pressure. Own the security strategy, roadmap and budget across Decentralized Masters, Legacy, Inflection Club, Sentinelis and future brands. Report posture, top risks and trends to leadership every month, with a risk register leadership can act on. Incident response. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied AI Engineer based in Netherlands. As an Applied AI Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing and building the next generation of intelligent, agentic systems. You will develop the core infrastructure that enables AI agents to manage context, use tools, coordinate tasks, and continuously improve their performance. Working at the intersection of advanced AI research and practical software engineering, you will transform complex operational workflows into reliable, scalable production solutions. You will establish robust evaluation, testing, and observability frameworks to ensure AI-powered systems deliver predictable and measurable results. You will also explore innovative ways to integrate coding agents and specialized subagents into software development processes. Collaborating closely with product and operational teams, you will identify high-impact automation opportunities and translate them into effective technical solutions. As an early core member of the engineering team, you will have significant influence over architectural decisions, technical standards, and the long-term AI strategy. Accountabilities In this role, you will design and implement the technical foundations of agentic systems while driving the adoption of AI-powered engineering workflows. Your responsibilities will include: Design and build essential components of agentic systems, including memory, context management, tool-calling capabilities, orchestration mechanisms, and feedback loops. Develop reusable AI infrastructure that enables new workflows to be introduced quickly, consistently, and with predictable reliability. Build comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, identify failure points, and understand the factors behind successful outcomes. Integrate testing, tracing, debugging, and evaluation into the software engine

It’s not a support desk, not a pre-sales role and not project management where others do the building. We are in stealth and very early, which means you can shape much of what comes next. What you'll own The product layer: Turn complex optimization systems into software planners can actually use. jobs.description: Who We Are At Progyny Global, part of the Progyny, Inc. family, we're on a mission to make fertility, pregnancy, and family-forming care accessible worldwide. By combining world-class clinical expertise with innovative technology, we deliver inclusive, culturally competent support that helps individuals and families navigate some of life's most important journeys. With Progyny's support and global reach, we're expanding access to care and breaking down barriers so that more people can build the families they want, wherever they are in the world. Role Overview We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Lead Claims Operations to lead our small claims team, strengthen our global claims operations, and drive the development of the tools that support our members and team. Our members come to us during one of the hardest phases of their lives. A fertility journey is physically and emotionally exhausting, and a slow reimbursement or an unclear answer adds stress nobody should have to carry. That is why member experience sits at the heart of every claims process we run: we respond fast, we explain decisions clearly, and we treat every piece of member feedback as important. We want our members to feel the difference to a traditional insurer at every step. This is a player-coach role combining team leadership, operational oversight, and product improvement. You’ll guide and develop the team, manage quality and workload, and continuously improve our processes. You’ll also stay close to daily operations by handling complex or escalated cases, reviewing selected claims, and stepping in during periods of increased demand. Your routine caseload will be significantly smaller than that of a Claims Processor, allowing you to focus where your experience and judgement have the greatest impact. Working closely with the VP Member Experience, Legal, Clinical Operations, and Finance, you’ll help maintain a fair, consistent, and compliant claims framework across our markets. jobs.title: Trading Manager
jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). jobs.title: Looking for native Swiss French speakers for a *non-professional* recording project
jobs.description: We are collaborating with one of our key clients on an exciting project to train AI bots used in call centers. The goal is to help these bots understand different intonations, speech cadences, and accents. If you’re a native Swiss French speaker and have a PC with a microphone, this opportunity is perfect for you! This project will start in May/June (we don’t know the exact timeline yet) Tasks What You’ll Do : Record approximately ~300 provided utterances (short phrases) in your native language, with each utterance saved as a separate file. Why You’re Needed : Your recordings will help train call-centre bots, enabling them to better understand diverse speech patterns. Note : These recordings will not be used for commercial purposes. Requirements NATIVE speakers of SWISS French (no linguistic or professional voiceover experience needed). A PC with a microphone. Ability to install and use the free recording software Audacity (we provide detailed setup instructions). A quiet environment for clear, noise-free recordings. Technical Specifications : Format : Single-channel WAV PCM. Frequency : 16 kHz. Silence : 0.5 seconds of silence at the beginning or end of each recording. To ensure a diverse pool of voices and verify that the recording environment meets the required standards (e.g., no background noise), we will ask shortlisted candidates to submit a short voice sample as part of the application process. jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst, Driver Supply
jobs.description: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. THE TEAM • ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years. Delivery companies have always bought capacity by guesswork. Book too few drivers and parcels wait; book too many and you pay for empty vans. Most carriers accept that waste as the price of being reliable. Relay is building a marketplace where it isn't. You can't schedule drivers. You can only design what's on offer, and measure what happens. Every part of our network runs on decisions. The next two years are about building the systems that make them well, and proving they do. Engineering and operational research build what you design. Marketplace Highlights You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what Marketplace changes on booking, matching and

Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. THE TEAM • ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation Every courier who works with Relay chooses their day. A day is a set of routes that have to fit together, and every courier's ideal day competes with everyone else's. Work is finite and every route still has to be covered, so matching thousands of couriers to the work they want is a recommendation problem with few precedents. Science at Relay is the brain of the operation: machine learning, operational research, recommender systems, causal inference, location intelligence and experimentation, working together to decide how every parcel gets delivered. There's no existing recommender to iterate on. You'll build it. Recommender Systems Highlights Combinatorial, constrained and competitive: every recommendation has to be feasible for the whole network, not just right for one courier. jobs.description: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. About us At Legora, we’re changing how lawyers work. jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer
jobs.description: About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. jobs.title: Paralegal / Legal Engineer
jobs.description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . Summary We're looking for an early-career legal professional to help drive how Legal works at Dust. You'll shape and build legal processes and tools, and you'll get directly involved in a broad range of commercial legal matters, working under the supervision of Dust's lawyers. This role combines legal engineering and process improvement with hands-on experience in commercial contracting, including customer, vendor and partner matters. With a view to qualifying as a solicitor, the role may lead to consideration for an England & Wales training contract, subject to performance, business needs, eligibility and formal approval. A training contract is a potential pathway, not a guarantee. What you'll do Drive legal engineering and process improvement Identify recurring legal bottlenecks and design better ways for the company to get legal support. Translate legal rules and approved playbooks into practical workflows, templates, structured guidance and automations. Build and improve legal workflows using Dust and other appropriate tools, including intake, contract review

jobs.description: Company Overview At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world. The Role As Product Manager - you will coordinate the engine that produces everything CoMind puts in front of the outside world — marketing collateral, conference materials, brand content, IFUs, and the claims we make about our products. You will take requests for content from across the business and turn them into finished, correctly reviewed output, keeping a clear, current record of what's in flight, what's overdue, and who it's waiting on. This is a hands-on role focused on the administration and operations of content. At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day. Responsibilities: Coordinate marketing collateral production: manage requests, keep templates and source files organised, control versioning, and route sign-off through Product, Commercial, and Regulatory before anything goes out. Own conference materials: booth collateral, printed and digital assets, deadlines, and vendor coordination for events. Generate brand content within established guidelines: copy adaptation, slide assets, and social/web content, escalating anything that needs new creative direction. Administer IFUs (Instructions for Use): keep documents current across product lines, track versions against released product configurations, and route changes through regulatory review. Maintain the claims matrix: keep it up to date, chase evidence and sign-off from Regulatory and Clinical, and flag claims that lack current support. jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.description: Accurx is where conversations happen with and about patients in the NHS For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that connects everyone through communication. What started as a way for GPs to text a patient, has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices and 68% (and growing!) of NHS Trusts. Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book that lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe , our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time. We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be. Gamechanging, right? Here's what you'll be getting stuck into to make it work As an Implementation Manager, you’ll be the one making sure our most ambitious tools actually land and stick in Secondary care. You won't just be ticking boxes on a rollout list; you’ll be leading the charge on high-impact transformations, like helping clinicians and admin teams move over to Accurx Scribe . You'll spend your time figuring out how these tools fit into the daily lives of clinicians, making sure they aren't just "installed," but are genuinely making things better for everyone. Driving deep transformation: Leading big-scale rollouts for complex products like Scribe, making sure we’re not just doing the basics but fundamentally changing how healthcare is delivered. jobs.title: ML Runtime Engineer
jobs.description: Wanna join the adventure? Loft's AI for Space group is building the stack that runs real machine learning in orbit; turning raw sensor data into decisions on the satellite itself, so insight reaches the customer in minutes instead of hours. The AI Engineering team is where models meet the spacecraft. We own the full path from a partner's trained model to something that actually runs — fast — on flight hardware: compiling ONNX models into optimized engines for each accelerator, the Space Inference Engine and its execution providers, the SDK that packages models for flight, and the perf tooling that proves a model fits its power, thermal, and latency budget before it ever leaves the ground. You'll move between model compilation, runtime internals, quantization, and hardware-in-the-loop CI, sometimes in the same afternoon. jobs.description: Mindset Chez Thiga, nous considérons qu’un Design System n’est pas seulement un ensemble de composants ou de règles : c’est un produit à part entière . Un produit pensé pour évoluer, répondre aux besoins des équipes, et accompagner la croissance de l’entreprise. Créer et faire vivre un Design System demande une vision , une stratégie claire , et une gouvernance solide . Il faut piloter son adoption, anticiper ses usages à grande échelle, et s’assurer qu’il réponde aux enjeux à la fois du Design et de la Tech. C’est un levier puissant pour faire monter en maturité les organisations, structurer la collaboration entre les équipes, et diffuser une culture produit forte. Aujourd'hui, un Design System bien structuré est aussi la condition sine qua non pour tirer pleinement parti de l'IA dans les workflows design et prototypage. Tokens cohérents, composants documentés, nomenclature rigoureuse autant de fondations qui permettent d'exploiter les outils d'IA générative (Figma Make, Lovable, v0...) de manière fiable et scalable. Le.la Design System Manager de demain est celui.celle qui anticipe ces usages et structure son système en conséquence. Les Design System Managers que nous recherchons pensent leur système comme un produit vivant, automatisé au maximum, et conçu pour connecter Design et Ingénierie dans un workflow sans friction . How we work together 🤝 Mettre en place des rituels d'adoption et d'amélioration continue :offices hours, sessions de feedback, contribution guidelines pour que le DS soit co-construit et adopté par toutes les équipes. Aligner Design et Engineering en continu : organiser des syncs réguliers avec les équipes dev pour garantir la cohérence entre les composants Figma et leur implémentation code. Le DS ne vit pas dans Figma seul; il vit dans la production. Piloter l'alignement stratégique multi-équipes : s'assurer que Produit, Tech, Design et business partagent la même vision et roadmap du DS, intégrée au même niveau que les autres produits. Répond

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description: About Kestra Kestra is the universal orchestration platform : open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems. Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide , including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole , Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars , hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community. About the role Kestra runs arbitrary, user-defined code at scale. Our users write workflows that execute scripts, containers, and queries against their own production systems, through hundreds of community-built plugins, on a platform whose entire source code is public. That is an unusually rich attack surface, and securing it is a genuinely hard engineering problem rather than a checklist exercise. You would be our first dedicated security hire. We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer to own and elevate the end-to-end security posture of our platform, infrastructure, and open-source ecosystem. This is a unique, hybrid role for someone who excels at both sides of security: actively breaking systems to find vulnerabilities (hands-on penetration testing) and actively fixing them (opening PRs, patching infrastructure, and managing supply chain risks). If you want to build a world-class security foundation for a fast-growing open-source and SaaS platform, this role is for you. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a GRC or compliance one. What you would do Your first six months would focus on the first three points below. The rest is where the role grows. Conduct hands-on penetration testing and threat modeling across our web application, APIs, control plane, and cloud environments. Manage end-to-end vulnerability tracking across our codebases, software dependencies (SCA), container images, and cloud infrastructure. jobs.description: Mines Saint-Etienne est une Ecole de l’Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT), 1er groupe public d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management en France. L’IMT est un EPSCP (grand établissement) sous la tutelle du Ministère de l’Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté Industrielle et Numérique. L’École Nationale Supérieure des Mines de Saint-Étienne (Mines Saint-Etienne) est chargée de missions de formation, de recherche et d’innovation, de transfert vers l’industrie et de culture scientifique, technique et industrielle. Mines Saint-Etienne représente: 2 400 élèves-ingénieurs et chercheurs en formation, 480 personnels (150 Chercheurs et Enseignants-chercheurs), un budget consolidé de 46 M€, 3 campus dédiés à l’industrie à Saint-Etienne et Lyon (région AURA), à la microélectronique et aux objets connectés à Gardanne (Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence, région SUD) et à l’ingénierie pour la santé à Saint-Etienne ; 6 unités de recherche ; 5 centres de formation et de recherche ; un centre de culture scientifique technique et industrielle leader en France « La Rotonde » (> 50 000 visiteurs / an). Contexte scientifique et objectifs du stage : Des dispositifs d’électronique organique ultra-flexibles, conformables et implantables incorporant une intelligence artificielle promettent de révolutionner la surveillance et le traitement en temps réel de maladies chroniques [1]. De tels systèmes pourraient être basés sur des transistors organiques électrochimiques (OECTs), exploitant des conducteurs polymères mixtes ion-électron (PMIECs) comme couches actives. jobs.description: Joining Mines Saint-Étienne means committing to an institution where science and innovation build a more sustainable future. It is a school of excellence where everyone has the opportunity to unlock their full potential and contribute to tackling the challenges of tomorrow. Ranked among the top engineering schools in France and recognized worldwide, our school, a member of the Institut Mines-Télécom , educates the talents of tomorrow while actively addressing major industrial, digital, and environmental challenges. By joining us, you become part of a community of 500 members of staff, 2,500 students and take part in an ambitious project: combining academic excellence, cutting-edge research, and positive societal impact. The Institut Mines-Télécom brings together France’s leading Grandes Ecoles to tackle major industrial, digital, energy, and environmental challenges. With its eight public Grandes Écoles and two affiliated Graduate Schools, it is the leading public institute dedicated to engineers and managers. Together, we imagine and build a sustainable future by educating the leaders who will shape tomorrow’s transitions. 🎯 What we expect from you As a Postdoctoral Researcher or Research Engineer, you will perform research and innovation activities in the field of soft electronics and optical sensing for artificial skin applications. Within the Centre of Microelectronics and the Flexible Electronics Department (FEL), you will contribute to the development of stretchable optical waveguides and their integration into artificial skin demonstrators. The flexible electronics department develops technological and scientific knowledge in the field of soft electronics. The department has a strong knowledge in the field of material and interface electrical and mechanical characterization. The activities of the department are regrouped in the 660m2-area platform.
